findings.detail: Data conflicts with EXP intent: actors 3-6 start/max 30 and classes 1-5 use [10,0,10,10], versus doc [4,50,150,1] and lower starts. Quest vars 62-66 receive +10..+50 in events.

At lv30 classes 1-5 share HP3382/ATK160/DEF100/AGI150. MOBA, crit2x, guard50%, buffs 2x25% and ATB sqrt(AGI)+1 are set. TP max 93/50/100/93, preserve on/off/off/on, regen 5/3/0/2; TCR=1.0 vs GDD 1.2/1.5.
22 enemies grant EXP/gold; none drops items. Normal gold=5-100, bosses=500-1000. Boss EXP 5000/2000/8000 conflicts with doc 113/120/150. Events have 23 gold gains and one +9300 EXP CE.
No code302 shop. Map057 opens Skill Shop with 80 IDs; 93 skills cost 100-1800 (default 1000), with full refunds. More Currencies gives 8 variable-23 buy/sell costs 80-550.

Sources: gold, EXP, items, quest points. Sinks: skill buys, TP spends, candidate variable-23 costs. Refunds and absent shop callers leave circulation/reachability runtime-pending; balance unvalidated.

publication_intent: Publish facts/drift/limits; no formulas, retuning or validation.
